title: PURITY AND THE SANCTITY OF LIFE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his father's wife...' 'Cursed is anyone who has sexual relations with any animal.' 'Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his sister...' 'Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his mother-in-law.' 'Cursed is anyone who kills their neighbour secretly.' Then all the people shall say, 'Amen!'" — Deut 27:20-24 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
These curses deal with two of the most serious areas of life: sexual purity and the sanctity of human life. God draws clear boundaries around sexual relationships within the family, and He condemns the secret taking of a neighbour's life. These are weighty, sobering matters.

Notice again the theme of secrecy — the murder here is done "secretly," in the dark, where human courts might never reach. But God sees. There is no such thing as a hidden sin before Him. What is done in the shadows is fully known to the One who judges rightly.

We may be tempted to skim past such passages as harsh or distant from our lives. But behind these commands stands a God who cares intensely about purity and about the preciousness of human life made in His image. His boundaries are not arbitrary restrictions; they are the loving guardrails of a holy God who knows what protects human dignity and flourishing.

None of us keeps God's law perfectly, in body or in heart — Jesus taught that even our thoughts fall under God's gaze (Matt 5:27-28). This is exactly why we need a Saviour. Christ died for sins of every kind, offering full cleansing to all who come to Him (1 John 1:7). God's high standard humbles us; His grace in Christ restores us.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I honour God's design for purity, even in my thoughts?
2. Do I truly believe nothing is hidden from God?
3. How does God's holiness drive me to depend on Christ's grace?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Holy God, You see all things, even what is hidden. Thank You for guardrails that protect life and purity, and for the grace of Christ that cleanses me. Keep my heart pure before You. Amen.
